name: strategist-2039
notes: Strategist v0 end to end (user decisions 2026-10-22): every non-player faction directed every 3 months, the game paused while the local watcher (tools/strategist.ps1, one headless Claude call per faction) answers. Run the watcher alongside: tools/strategist.ps1 -Harness -StopAfterMinutes 120 (it follows the newest run folder; each run keeps its exchange files in lab/results/<run>/strategist). Checkpoints at the start, June and September 2039.
asserts: all(len(e['applied']) >= 7 for e in events('strategist', ev='applied'))
all(e['t'] == e['checkpoint'] for e in events('strategist', ev='applied'))
info: [(e['t'], e['ev'], e.get('applied'), e.get('ignored')) for e in events('strategist')]
[(e['t'], k, v.get('intent')) for e in events('strategist', ev='applied') for k, v in e['directives'].items()]

[(e['t'], {k: {f: v.get(f) for f in ('posture', 'strikeTargets', 'spare', 'raidFactions', 'warChestMonths', 'rivals', 'friends', 'defend') if v.get(f) is not None} for k, v in e['directives'].items()}) for e in events('strategist', ev='applied')]
[(e['t'], e['faction'], e['system'], e['target']) for e in events('strategist-defend')]
[(e['t'], e['faction'], e['source']) for e in events('strategist-intel')]
[(e['t'][:7], e['target'], e['targetSystem'], round(e['need']), round(e['have']), round(e['present'])) for e in events('pool')][:12]

{f: (faction(first, f).get('scv'), faction(last, f).get('scv'), faction(last, f).get('bases', 0) + faction(last, f).get('stations', 0)) for f in ['AlienCouncil', 'ResistCouncil', 'DestroyCouncil', 'CooperateCouncil', 'ExploitCouncil', 'EscapeCouncil', 'SubmitCouncil', 'AppeaseCouncil']}
